name: copy-browser-url
title: Copy Browser URL
description: Copy the current browser tab URL with tracking parameters removed. Removes UTM, Google Analytics, Facebook, and other tracking parameters from URLs.
author: tommy

commands.name: copy-browser-url
commands.title: Copy Browser URL
commands.subtitle: Copy URL from browser tab
commands.description: Copy the current browser tab URL to clipboard. Optionally remove tracking parameters (UTM, Google Analytics, Facebook, etc.) based on your preferences.

preferences.name: enableSanitization
preferences.title: URL Sanitization
preferences.description: Remove tracking parameters from URLs (UTM, Google Analytics, Facebook, etc.)
preferences.label: Enable URL sanitization

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
